text: July payrolls unexpectedly fell 23,000 while markets are now pricing in rate hikes instead of cuts — this stagflation-lite mix of slowing growth (GDP down to 1.5%) with sticky 3.4% inflation means the economy is losing momentum and the Fed has less room to help, so tighten your stops and hold off on adding risk.
Raise your stop on BE from $117.21 to $123.47 to lock in more protection while you watch whether that 37% revenue growth can offset the insider selling and 40% drawdown from highs.
